_comment: User-extensible Optimization Mods ('Modes'). Add or edit profiles here and run: python main.py modes

4k-ultra.title: 4K Ultra & Ray Tracing
4k-ultra.description: Prioritizes 16GB+ VRAM flagship/high-tier GPUs, modern PCIe 4.0/5.0 platforms, and Tier A/B ATX 3.0 PSUs.

itx-compact.title: Small Form Factor (ITX / mATX)
itx-compact.description: Targets compact ITX/mATX motherboards, low-TDP cool-running silicon, and SFX/modular high-efficiency PSUs.

creator-pro.title: Video Editing, 3D & Productivity
creator-pro.description: Balances high-thread CPU throughput (16-32 threads), 32-64GB RAM capacity, NVIDIA NVENC/CUDA VRAM, and rock-solid VRM/PSU tiers.
